messages:
maria: Hey — multiple customers reporting streaming sessions drop silently after ~65s idle. reconnect resumes but sometimes replays the last chunk and the app sees duplicate tokens. cc @jordan
jordan: I saw similar in staging this morning. proxy seems to close idle sockets at 66s, client retries with resume token; resume path occasionally replays vs dedupe not applied
kevin: console traces show a route flip exactly at reconnect. suspect sticky routing TTL mismatch between proxy and router (lease vs conn idle)
maria: repro: connect -> idle 65s -> proxy emits EOF -> client reconnects with resume-id -> sometimes get 'stream_chunk' twice
jordan: snippets from logs: proxy: conn_idle_timeout=66s -> close; router: session_lease_ttl=60s; resume token valid but session assigned to different backend -> backend doesn't have kvcache -> fallthrough replay
kevin: that explains duplicates. billing saw token charges twice in the ingest+resume cycle :grimacing:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for streaming-router v3.2 -> 10% hosts
maria: quick mitigations?
jordan: options: 1) bump session_lease_ttl to 120s (keeps stickiness longer) 2) make proxy send keepalive pings at ~30s 3) make resume idempotent: include last-ack seq in resume token so backend can dedupe
kevin: prefer (3) + keepalive short-term. suggested config patch:
```
streaming:
  proxy:
    keepalive_interval: 30s
  router:
    session_lease_ttl: 120s
```
maria: UX/console note: when resume causes duplicates we should surface a 'resume-duplicate' alert on the per-route dashboard and mark the request trace as 'replayed' so SREs can filter
jordan: telemetry we need: resume_attempts, resume_dupes, resume_miss_kvcache, route_flip_count. track by tenant and region
kevin: rollout plan: patch proxy keepalive to canary -> 5 hosts -> monitor resume_dupes and billing spikes for 1h -> expand if clean
maria: @oncall can we hotfix for Dedicated customers now?
jordan: I can push proxy keepalive hotfix tonight. will set canary and manual rollback. also tagging @billing to pause duplicate billing until dedupe PR lands
kevin: also add console feature flag 'prefer_resume' to prefer resuming over full reconnect for flaky clients. default true for hosted
maria: agree. add unit test in router harness for resume idempotency (simulate kvcache miss vs replay)
deploy-bot: deploy started: proxy-hotfix-1765432100 -> canary 5 hosts :shipit:
kevin: monitoring queries I'll add: 
- sum(rate(resume_dupes[5m]))
- sum(rate(route_flip_count[5m])) by region
maria: thanks — followups: PRs for router dedupe, proxy keepalive, console metric tile. will sync in next standup :eyes:
